# Copilot Instructions

## Project
Build and maintain a Sudoku game using Python Flask,
HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

## Code Quality
- Follow Python PEP 8 standards.
- Write clean and reusable code.
- Use meaningful variable names.
- Keep backend and frontend logic separate.
- Add comments where necessary.
- Handle errors properly.

## Sudoku Logic
- Generate valid Sudoku puzzles.
- Ensure each puzzle has exactly one solution.
- Support Easy, Medium and Hard difficulties.
- Lock prefilled cells.
- Implement Hint and Check functionality.
- Show incorrect entries immediately.

## Game Features
- Add a timer.
- Save the Top 10 scores in localStorage.
- Store player name, time, difficulty and hints.
- Implement dark mode.
- Create responsive layouts.
- Use alternating 3x3 grid colors.

## Testing
- Use pytest for automated testing.
- Run tests after modifications.
- Preserve existing functionality.
- Fix errors before completing changes.

## Copilot Usage
- Review suggestions before accepting them.
- Avoid unnecessary complexity.
- Explain important code changes.
- Prioritize accessibility and maintainability.
